files.time.title: Tooltip and aria-label of the small time tag ("3h") beside a file name in the file list; {t} = the time point with its unit, e.g. "3 h".
storia.tolto: Notice shown for 6 s after removing a file, closing a panel or clearing the marks, with the Undo button; {what} = name of the file, of the panel or "marks".
storia.undone: Announcement after Ctrl/Cmd+Z; {what} = short name of the undone action (zoom, integration, background...).
storia.redone: Announcement after Redo; {what} = short name of the redone action.
spec.bgAuto: After "background subtracted" in the spectrum legend; {a}, {b} = ends of the segment chosen by the program (min).
xic.lowRes: Below the row of an ion in the XIC window; {unit} = m/z window (HTML).
xic.shifted: {base} = starting m/z, {shift} = signed offset in Da (e.g. +16), {mz} = resulting m/z (HTML).
tip.more: Mouse box on the chromatogram: traces not listed.
pk.loss: Line of the peak box on an MS2/MSn spectrum; {d} = signed m/z shift from the precursor (e.g. −71.0), {prec} = precursor m/z, {nl} = the neutral loss.
pk.close: Line of the peak box: {n} more peaks lie within a few pixels of the one shown.
pk.keys: Description read for the spectrum plot: which keys walk the peaks.
tip.peak: Mouse box on a spectrum peak; {y} = value (with % if relative), {abs} = HTML with the absolute cps or empty.
spec.follow.aria: Accessible label of the chip of the linked spectrum; {n} = panel number.
spec.follow.item: Entry of the chip menu: a chromatogram to follow; {n} = panel number, {title} = its title.
xic.ionN: Label of a row of the XIC window; {n} = ion number (2-10).
spec.contRemoved: Note in the spectrum legend; {n} = number of peaks removed because they match a Keller contaminant.
press.read: Reading next to the pressure curve; {t} = time, {p} = value, {u} = unit (bar if the file declares a pressure unit, otherwise the file's own).
press.read.cursor: Part of the cursor reading; {p} = value at the cursor time, {u} = unit.
twc.read: Reading next to the TWC curve on the MRM panel; {t} = time, {v} = absorbance in mAU.
twc.read.cursor: Part of the cursor reading on the MRM panel; {v} = TWC absorbance at the cursor time.
tdati.rows: Counter below the data table; {n} = number of rows.
tdati.rowsOf: Counter below a truncated data table; {shown} = rows kept, {n} = rows of the chart.
tdati.capped: Note above a data table with more rows than the cap (200 000): the first ones are kept, shown and copied, and it says where to get them all. {shown} = rows kept, {n} = rows of the chart.
tdati.region: Label of the scrollable area of the table; {title} = chart title.
tdati.apex: Table row for an integrated peak; {a}, {b} = ends in min.
tdati.int.a: Data table row for the start of an integrated peak, where the area touches the baseline; {a}, {b} = ends in min.
tdati.int.b: Data table row for the end of an integrated peak, where the area touches the baseline; {a}, {b} = ends in min.
int.end.a: Accessible name of the handle at the start of the area, on the baseline (to drag with mouse, finger or pen, or to move with the arrow keys); {rt} = time in minutes.
int.end.b: Accessible name of the handle at the end of the area, on the baseline (to drag or to move with the arrow keys); {rt} = time in minutes.
int.end.liveA: Text read by the screen reader after the start of the area is moved; {rt} = time in minutes, {area} = area in scientific notation.
int.end.liveB: Text read by the screen reader after the end of the area is moved; {rt} = time in minutes, {area} = area in scientific notation.
tdati.note.line: Note above the table; {a}, {b} = time ends, {n} = maximum rows per trace.
tdati.note.spec: Note above the table; {thr} = threshold in %, {a}, {b} = m/z ends.
tdati.note.map: Note above the table; {n} = number of cells.
tdati.series: Name of a series of a chart without a name; {n} = sequence number.
spec.measure.toLosses: Menu entry after a measurement with the ruler; {d} = m/z difference.
spec.par.thr: "Parameters" popover of the spectrum; {input} = numeric field (HTML).
spec.scanLine.avg: Line above the spectrum when the average of several scans is shown; {n} = number of scans.
spec.scanLine.ce: Line above the spectrum: collision energy; {ce} = value in eV.
spec.scanLine.merge: Line above the spectrum: says the engine merges the centroids of the same nominal mass (low-resolution files).
tbl.pt.monoOnly: Line of the element card when only the monoisotopic mass is known; {m} = mass (number).
tbl.pt.card: Line of the element card in the periodic table; {w} = average mass, {m} = monoisotopic mass (numbers).
tbl.pt.aria: Screen-reader name of an element tile; {name}, {s} = symbol, {z} = atomic number, {cls} = class, {m} = monoisotopic mass, {w} = average mass.
tbl.pt.ariaMono: Screen-reader name of an element tile with only the monoisotopic mass; {name}, {s}, {z}, {cls} = class, {m} = mass.
tbl.pt.ariaNone: Screen-reader name of an element tile without isotope data; {name}, {s}, {z}, {cls} = class.
tbl.loss.detail: Detail of a neutral loss; {m} = exact mass, {mech} = mechanism text.
tree.xlsx.prefix: Start of the downloaded file name; only letters, numbers and underscore.
msnl.count: Count above the list of MSn experiments; {n} = scans shown, {g} = precursors shown.
msnl.tic.aria: Label of the TIC button of a precursor row; {mz} = precursor m/z.
msnl.xic.aria: Label of the XIC button of a precursor row; {mz} = precursor m/z.
tree.nodeInfo: Line above the peaks table of a node of the MSn tree.
release.new: Desktop app notice when a newer version exists; {version} = version number, already formatted (for example 1.2.0).
update.available: Desktop app update message; {files} = number of changed files to download, {size} = megabytes, already formatted.
update.newapp.nolink: Like update.newapp but without a link (installers not public on the site): complete sentence; {min} = minimum version.
update.newapp: Updating the web part requires a newer desktop app; {min} = minimum version (e.g. 0.2.0). After the sentence the link to the installers page appears.
update.progress: Progress of the update download; {done} = files downloaded, {total} = files to download, {size} = megabytes downloaded so far.
workflow.err.tooBig: A file read safely (.mzflow, lists, sample tables) exceeds the byte cap and is not opened; {mb} = cap in MB (already formatted).
workflow.err.tooDeep: A JSON file read safely has too many nested levels and is not opened; {n} = maximum levels (already formatted).
workflow.err.tooMany: A JSON file read safely has too many values and is not opened; {n} = maximum values (already formatted).
workflow.warn.unknownOps: Warning when opening a .mzflow file with unknown operations (ignored); {ops} = names of the operations.
workflow.warn.shaMismatch: Warning when the SHA-256 fingerprint differs from that of the flow; {file} = file name, {actual} = computed fingerprint, {expected} = expected fingerprint.
spec.noPrec: Product spectrum (MS2) panel: no file shown has the precursor of the panel; {v} = precursor m/z.
qaqc.ratio.atleast: Column header of the QA/QC panel: the sample/blank ratio reaches the chosen threshold. {thr} = 3 or 10.
qaqc.ratio.sum: Line above the sample/blank ratio table of an ion. {mz} = m/z, {blank} = mean area of the blanks, {thr} = threshold (3 or 10).
qaqc.remove: Accessible label of the × button that removes a control ion. {n} = name of the ion.
qaqc.role.of: Accessible label of the file type menu in the QA/QC panel. {f} = file name.
qaqc.sum.cv: Summary row of the QA/QC panel: coefficient of variation of the area. {v} = percentage.
qaqc.sum.cvqc: Summary row of the QA/QC panel: coefficient of variation of the area in the QCs. {v} = percentage.
qaqc.sum.drift: Summary row: slope of the RT along the file order. {v} = minutes per file.
qaqc.sum.ppm: Summary row (high resolution): mass error. {mean} = mean, {max} = maximum absolute (ppm), {n} = files measured.
qaqc.chart.rt: Accessible title of the RT shift chart. {ion} = name of the ion.
qaqc.chart.area: Accessible title of the relative area chart. {ion} = name of the ion.
qaqc.feat.sum: Line above the Tabui features table. {n} = features reaching the threshold, {tot} = total, {thr} = threshold, {b} = blanks.
rep.sub: Line below the title of the study report. {name} = program name, {ver} = version, {commit} = commit, {date} = UTC date and time.
rep.s1.sum: Summary of the study design. {n} = files, {s} samples, {b} blanks, {q} QCs, {st} standards, {d} dark.
rep.s3.prog: Row of the Processing section. {name} = program, {ver} = version, {commit} = commit.
prof.chart.aria: Accessible label of the time profile chart. {ion} = label of the chosen ion.
prof.sum: Line above the time profile chart. {mz} = m/z, {rt} = expected RT in minutes.
prof.sum.istd: Continuation of the profile line when it is normalized. {istd} = label of the internal standard.
unopen.known.no: Row of the single notice: several files of a recognized but unsupported instrument format; {n} = how many, {label} = vendor and format, e.g. "SCIEX .wiff2". Do not translate vendor and format names.
unopen.known.no.one: Like unopen.known.no for a single file; {label} = vendor and format.
unopen.known.conv: Row of the single notice: several files of a recognized format that the browser does not open; they must be converted to mzML ("How to convert" guide); {n} = how many, {label} = vendor and format.
unopen.known.conv.one: Like unopen.known.conv for a single file; {label} = vendor and format.
unopen.more: Last row of the list of names in the single notice; {n} = how many names are not shown.
unopen.other: Row of the single notice: files ignored because they are not known mass spectrometry files; {n} = how many, {names} = first names.
unopen.other.one: Same notice when exactly one file is ignored; {names} = its name.
unopen.err.one: Read error row for a single file in the single notice; {name} = file, {message} = reason.
unopen.err.many: Read error row that is the same for several files; {n} = how many, {names} = first names, {message} = reason.
sub.chip: {file} = name of the reference file (with "(auto)" if chosen automatically); {f} = factor; {norm} = normalization.
sub.factor.vt: {f} = multiplicative factor of the reference (number with two decimals).
sub.file.auto: {file} = name of the file the program would choose automatically.
sub.norm.istd.short: {mz} = m/z of the internal standard chosen by the student.
tip.raw: Small value in the mouse box, next to the corrected one. {v} = value of the trace before the background, already formatted.
warn.msngrafo.fixedNotFound: Warning: the formula chosen by the user is not among the candidates of the node; {node} = m/z of the node.
warn.msngrafo.isolatedUnexplained: Warning: an isolated precursor has no candidate formulas and was removed; {node} = m/z.
warn.msngrafo.mostUnexplained: Warning: more than half of the fragment intensity has no candidate formulas (wrong formula or adduct?).
warn.msngrafo.isolation: Warning: several peaks in the isolation window; {node} = m/z of the node.
warn.msngrafo.precNotFound: Warning: the precursor is not in the parent spectrum; {node} = m/z of the node.
warn.msngrafo.userConflict: Warning: the formula chosen by the user conflicts with the precursor; {node} = m/z of the node.
tdati.note.uv: Note above the UV spectrum table; {a}-{b} nm, {n} = maximum rows.
uv.leg.mean: Legend of the mean UV spectrum; {rt} = RT interval (min), {n} = number of averaged spectra.
uv.reading: Notice below the PDA trace while the UV matrix of a file is read at the first double click (once per file).
uv.leg.one: Legend of the UV spectrum of a single instant; {rt} = RT (min).
tdati.etpk: Table row for a labelled peak (the time of the peak); {v} = label text, e.g. "14.26 min".
load.note.logs.one: Loading note for a skipped log file (for example the .wiff.log of msconvert); {names} = file name.
load.note.logs: Loading note for the skipped log files (for example the .wiff.log files of msconvert); {n} = how many, {names} = the first names.
